races.paceDynamic: Nordic Norm and Beta Reader will lead the early pace, with Nordic Norm likely taking them along at a sustainable gallop given the lack of other confirmed front-runners. The strong contingent of hold-up horses (Magical Merlin, Penfolds Grange, Caph Star, Billy Mill, Havana Touch, King Of Charm, Chico Dulce) will create a cavalry charge finish if the pace becomes too steady.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Nordic Norm and Beta Reader set uncontested fractions through halfway
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets perfect conditions with plenty of horse left for the final two furlongs. The closers swamp the leaders with Caph Star and Penfolds Grange having class edges in the late surge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Pressure Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Beta Reader puts pressure on Nordic Norm or other horses join the early battle
scenarios.body: The increased gallop stretches the field and reduces the kick from the back markers. Nordic Norm's prominent style and recent good form allows him to capitalize on the honest pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Compression
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate but quickens significantly from the 4-furlong pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical with the field bunched turning for home, creating traffic problems for some closers. Those with racing room and instant acceleration prevail in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Nordic Norm and Beta Reader go too slow and the field crawls into the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the 2-furlong marker favoring those with the best turn of foot regardless of position. The highest-rated closers with recent sharp form get first run on the field.

watchPoints.text: Nordic Norm must be watched for signs of stopping in final furlong if pace becomes genuine

races.paceDynamic: Pureis King will take the field along at a sustainable pace with no other confirmed pace-setters in this field of predominantly hold-up performers. The massive field of 13 hold-up horses behind the lone leader creates a compressed finish where positioning and a clear run will be crucial. This sets up a tactical affair where the early leader may have enough left to resist late challengers if the pace stays reasonable.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pureis King Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and Pureis King gets breathing space
scenarios.body: The leader builds a useful advantage through the middle stages and has enough left to resist the late charge. The hold-up horses get in each other's way in a crowded finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the top-rated horses get clear runs in the straight
scenarios.body: West Hill Rosie and the 120-rated trio unleash their superior ability despite the tactical disadvantage. Late runs sweep past a tired leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Range Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems affect the favorites and mid-rated horses find gaps
scenarios.body: Horses like Winding Stream and Claytons Kolatonic benefit from cleaner passages while higher-rated rivals get stopped. Form horses with proven stamina capitalize.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys panic early and pressure Pureis King into fast fractions
scenarios.body: The pace collapses completely with multiple horses making premature moves. An outsider who stays out of trouble benefits from the carnage up front.

races.paceDynamic: Pints In Peace is the only natural early pace, likely to dictate terms uncontested from the front alongside Black Endeavour who can also race prominently. The majority of the field (Shafi, Ahead Of Fashion, Deluded, Lion Of Mali, Twilight Glow, Storm Point) are hold-up horses who will need the race to develop, creating a potentially stop-start rhythm that could suit patient tactics.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Pints In Peace gets soft fractions with no pressure from Black Endeavour
scenarios.body: Pints In Peace controls the tempo completely and has enough left to resist the late charge. The hold-up brigade leaves their runs too late on a pace that never truly collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Duel Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Black Endeavour and Pints In Peace go too hard in the early stages
scenarios.body: Both prominent runners weaken in the final furlong after setting unsustainable fractions. The closers get the perfect setup with Lion Of Mali and Deluded timing their runs perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Slow Pace
scenarios.trigger: If both Pints In Peace and Black Endeavour go too steady early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 3f pole with positioning crucial. Shafi and Storm Point, despite being hold-up horses, benefit from the tactical nature and superior class tells.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Perfect Tracking Trip
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is moderate and one closer gets the ideal tracking position
scenarios.body: A hold-up horse like Twilight Glow or Ahead Of Fashion gets the dream run behind the leaders. They sweep past tired leaders but need everything to fall right.

races.paceDynamic: Parisian Scholar will set the pace uncontested as the sole leader, with Starship Trooper likely tracking in second position given his prominent running style. This creates a moderate, sustainable gallop that will heavily favor the quartet of hold-up horses (Moment Of Light, Green Falcon, Devil's Peak) who can unleash finishing kicks in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Parisian Scholar Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If the leader maintains a steady tempo without being pressured early
scenarios.body: Parisian Scholar dictates throughout and has enough left to resist late challengers. Starship Trooper's prominent position gives him first crack at the leader but the hold-up horses finish too late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Finishing Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace allows the hold-up horses to unleash powerful finishing bursts
scenarios.body: Moment Of Light and Devil's Peak produce their trademark late runs to sweep past the pace-setter in the final furlong. Green Falcon also benefits from the setup but lacks the class of the front two finishers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Starship Trooper Times Move
scenarios.trigger: If Starship Trooper tracks perfectly and moves decisively turning for home
scenarios.body: The prominent runner gets first jump on his rivals and builds enough of a lead to hold off the closers. Parisian Scholar fades after setting the pace while the hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by the early move.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Starship Trooper applies early pressure or others break from intended tactics
scenarios.body: The pace becomes genuinely testing as positions get shuffled early, setting up a sprint finish. Green Falcon and Devil's Peak benefit most from the faster tempo that stretches the field.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Starship Trooper breaks from his usual prominent style to press Parisian Scholar early - this would create unsustainable pace

scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Chhota Saab maintains uncontested lead and prominent runners settle kindly

scenarios.trigger: If several prominent runners pressure Chhota Saab creating faster fractions

races.paceDynamic: True Promise is the sole pace-setter in a field dominated by hold-up performers, likely to lead uncontested through comfortable fractions. With nine hold-up runners bunched behind, this creates a tactical nightmare where positioning and room at the business end become critical, potentially favoring those who can secure the best tracks early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Pace Holds Up
scenarios.trigger: If True Promise maintains steady gallop without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets soft lead through moderate fractions then kicks clear when the field comes hunting. The hold-up brigade gets in each other's way as they all come with late runs simultaneously.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Weakens Late
scenarios.trigger: If True Promise goes too fast early or tires in final furlong
scenarios.body: The early leader sets up the race perfectly for the closers who swarm past in the final 100 yards. The best-positioned hold-up horses with clearest runs prevail as True Promise fades.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Drawn Out Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If another runner joins True Promise for early lead
scenarios.body: Dual pace creates strong gallop that sets up ideal scenario for hold-up runners to close into. The early speed horses compromise each other allowing the best closer to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys get too cute and True Promise goes very slowly
scenarios.body: The race becomes stop-start with bunching and limited gallop until late sprint finish. Best turn of foot from the pack wins but traffic problems can affect any runner.
